artifactReferences.description: Spec-investigation bundles legitimately carry zero artifact references when no spec has been generated yet (story 2.8 AC3); minItems relaxed from 1 to 0 in-place as a backward-compatible v1 patch (existing producers always passed >=1; consumers must already accept 0+).

repositoryWorkspaceRef.description: Story 3a-2 (AC1) — OPTIONAL. The deterministic container mount path the runner reads the cloned working tree from. Emitted by the spec-investigation bundle ONLY when a repository workspace was prepared for the run; absent (with the four sibling repo fields) for every no-repo and execution-stage bundle, which therefore stay byte-identical to the story-2.8 baseline. Additive backward-compatible v1 patch (NOT in required; mirrors the minItems 1->0 precedent above); schemaVersion stays const:1.

repositoryTreeSummary.description: Story 3a-2 (AC1) — OPTIONAL, redacted. Depth-limited top-level tree listing of the cloned working tree (.gitignore-respecting, entry-capped). Embedded content; redacted by the single shareable-redacted pass.

repositoryReadmeRef.description: Story 3a-2 (AC1) — OPTIONAL. Mount-relative path to the detected README (reference-by-path, Decision D4), or null when none exists. Never a host absolute path (Trap T7).

packageManifestRefs.description: Story 3a-2 (AC1) — OPTIONAL. Mount-relative references to detected package/build manifests (package.json / pom.xml / Cargo.toml / build.gradle / go.mod / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml). Reference-by-path, not embedded bodies (Decision D4).

ticketRepositoryMappingVersion.description: Story 3a-2 (AC1, Decision D2) — OPTIONAL. Marker for which Linear<->GitHub mapping resolved to this repo. Config-derived for the pilot (e.g. config:<repoKey>@1); a real mapping version is deferred to stories 3.32/3.33.

approvedImplementationPlanReference.description: Story 3.10 (AC2) — OPTIONAL. Reference to the approved implementation-plan artifact carried into the pr-output sub-stage bundle (mirrors approvedSpecificationReference). Null/absent for the implementation-plan sub-stage, spec-investigation, and legacy bundles. Additive backward-compatible v1 patch (NOT in required; mirrors the 3a-2 repo-field precedent + the minItems 1->0 precedent above); schemaVersion stays const:1. The referenced payload is read from the mounted input dir, never embedded inline (AC7).

repositoryBranchRef.description: Story 3.10 (AC2) — OPTIONAL. The expected deterministic feature-branch name (story 3.9 AC2 convention, e.g. deliveryline/{ticketSlug}/stage-{runIdShort}) the runner pushes to. A git ref, NEVER a host absolute path (Trap T5). Emitted only when a repository workspace was prepared; absent on no-repo dispatches.

acceptedClarifications.description: Story 3e-2 (AC3) — OPTIONAL. The run's ACCEPTED clarifications (question + reviewer answer) fed into a spec REGENERATION so the runner can incorporate the answers. Unlike every other feedback channel (reference-by-id only), the answer content is carried INLINE here because the runner reads only this bundle — the whole bundle is policed by the single shareable-redacted redaction pass, so the reviewer-authored answer text is redacted exactly like artifact content. Emitted ONLY at the spec-investigation stage and ONLY when >=1 accepted clarification exists; absent otherwise so a no-clarification rebuild stays byte-identical. Each entry is also mirrored as a {referenceId, kind:'clarification.answered'} priorFeedbackReferences row. Additive backward-compatible v1 patch (NOT in required); schemaVersion stays const:1.
